about: Vishal Nirmiti Limited is engaged in manufacturing pre-stressed concrete (PSC) sleepers for railways, pre-cast and prestressed concrete products, fabrication and erection of mild steel pipes (MS pipes), MS liners, and penstock pipes for pumped storage projects. The company also generates power through windmills and provides infrastructure construction services. Its manufacturing facilities and project sites are located across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Haryana, and Himachal Pradesh.

objects.purpose: Funding Working Capital Requirements of the Company
Repayment and/ or pre-payment, in part or full of term loans availed by our Company

concentration.note: Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Gujarat accounted for 35.52%, 33.96%, and 17.90% of FY26 revenue respectively (total 87.38%).

litigation_note: The company, one promoter, director, and an employee were named in an FIR under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988. Total contingent liabilities stood at ₹21.87 crore as of March 31, 2026.
strengths: Integrated manufacturing operations delivering comprehensive solutions in PSC sleepers and MS pipes.
Technical capabilities enhanced by partnerships with global prestressed concrete sleeper and pipe manufacturers.
Strong order book providing robust multi-year revenue visibility with railway departments and infrastructure clients.
Experienced promoters and dedicated management team with deep domain knowledge in railway infrastructure.

risks.title: Substantial Dependence on Government Railroad Projects
risks.detail: Government railroad projects accounted for 42.61% (₹144.21 crore) of revenue in FY26, making the company vulnerable to railway budget shifts.

risks.title: Geographical Revenue Concentration
risks.detail: 87.38% of FY26 revenue came from three states: Maharashtra (35.52%), Madhya Pradesh (33.96%), and Gujarat (17.90%).

risks.title: FIR Under Prevention of Corruption Act
risks.detail: The company, a promoter, director, and employee were cited in an FIR under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.

risks.title: High Borrowings and Debt Obligations
risks.detail: Total borrowings were ₹87.42 crore as of March 31, 2026, with a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.01:1.

risks.title: Manufacturing Vertical Concentration
risks.detail: Manufacturing vertical accounted for 75.01%, 76.54%, and 88.26% of revenue in FY26, FY25, and FY24 respectively.

risks.title: Contingent Liabilities Exposure
risks.detail: Contingent liabilities totaled ₹21.87 crore as of March 31, 2026, primarily consisting of ₹20.02 crore in bank guarantees.

risks.title: Recallable Unsecured Loans
risks.detail: The company has ₹19.73 crore in unsecured borrowings from related parties and shareholders as of June 30, 2026, recallable anytime.

risks.title: Absence of Freehold Title for Mohol Facility
risks.detail: The Mohol sleeper manufacturing plant is situated on promoter-owned land under an agreement for sale; final deed execution is pending.

notes: Share split from ₹100 to ₹10 took place on Feb 20, 2025; 10:1 bonus issue was completed on Sep 17, 2025; order book as of June 30, 2026 was ₹581.77 crore.
